description: GO molecular-function transfer test: do the confident structural homologs of ADAMTSL1 segments share any informative MF term?
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Computed in this job: GO molecular-function terms of every protein behind a
# confident (E < 1e-3) Foldseek pdb100 hit, grouped by ADAMTSL1 query segment.
# Source table: provenance/TABLE_homolog_GO_MF_transfer.csv

data = {
 "TSR1 / TSR2-4 / TSR5-9\n(TSP-1, ADAMTS13)": [
   ("heparin binding","GO:0008201",1),("integrin binding","GO:0005178",2),
   ("fibronectin binding","GO:0001968",1),("laminin binding","GO:0043236",1),
   ("collagen V binding","GO:0070052",1),("ECM structural constituent","GO:0005201",1),
   ("FGF binding","GO:0017134",1),("protease binding","GO:0002020",1),
   ("calcium ion binding","GO:0005509",2),("metalloendopeptidase activity","GO:0004222",1)],
 "CysRich + Spacer\n(ADAMTS13, CspB)": [
   ("metalloendopeptidase activity","GO:0004222",1),("metallopeptidase activity","GO:0008237",1),
   ("zinc ion binding","GO:0008270",1),("serine-type endopeptidase","GO:0004252",1),
   ("integrin binding","GO:0005178",1),("calcium ion binding","GO:0005509",1)],
 "Ig1 and Ig2-Ig4\n(DCC, Robo1, sidekick, titin,\nobscurin, UNC-5, contactin-4)": [
   ("identical protein binding","GO:0042802",6),("ATP binding","GO:0005524",3),
   ("calcium ion binding","GO:0005509",3),("protein ser/thr kinase","GO:0004674",2),
   ("structural constituent of muscle","GO:0008307",2),("protein tyr kinase","GO:0004713",2),
   ("axon guidance receptor activity","GO:0008046",2),("netrin receptor activity","GO:0005042",1),
   ("LRR domain binding","GO:0030275",2),("protein tyr phosphatase","GO:0004725",1)],
}

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1,3, figsize=(16,6.2))
for ax,(title,items) in zip(axes, data.items()):
    items = sorted(items, key=lambda t:t[2])
    y = np.arange(len(items))
    ax.barh(y,[i[2] for i in items], color="#6a9fb5", edgecolor="black", lw=0.5)
    ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels([f"{i[0]}" for i in items], fontsize=8.5)
    ax.set_xlabel("number of homolog proteins carrying the term")
    ax.set_title(title, fontsize=9.5, loc="left")
    ax.set_xlim(0,6.6)
    for yy,i in zip(y,items):
        ax.text(i[2]+0.12, yy, i[1], va="center", fontsize=6.5, color="#444444")
fig.suptitle("GO molecular-function terms carried by the proteins behind every confident Foldseek hit (E < 1e-3), by ADAMTSL1 segment.\n"
             "No informative MF term recurs across segments. Terms such as metalloendopeptidase activity, kinase activity and\n"
             "structural constituent of muscle come from domains the homologs have and ADAMTSL1 does not, so domain-level fold\n"
             "homology here does not license MF transfer.", fontsize=10, y=1.06, x=0.01, ha="left")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# Overlap test: which MF terms are shared by >=2 of the three homolog sets?
sets = {k:{t[0] for t in v} for k,v in data.items()}
import itertools, collections
cnt = collections.Counter()
for k,v in sets.items():
    for t in v: cnt[t]+=1
shared = {t:n for t,n in cnt.items() if n>=2}
print("MF terms shared by >=2 of the 3 structural-homolog sets:")
for t,n in sorted(shared.items(), key=lambda x:-x[1]): print(f"  {n}/3  {t}")
print("\nMF terms unique to one set:", sum(1 for n in cnt.values() if n==1), "of", len(cnt))
